title: Material Replacer
body:
A mod that adds a command `/rem` to replace material in an area.

For example: `/rem 0 0 0 11 45 14 oak spruce` replaces all oak blocks in this range into spruce blocks and keep their blockstates (facing direction, waterlog, etc.) as much as possible.

Regular Expressions are supported. for example, `/rem 0 0 0 11 45 14 "black|blue" white` replaces all black or blue dyed block into white version.
